name: Smells Like Nirvana
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Stereo Garden (Patchogue) - concerts and dance parties. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Touring act based in Chicago, not Long Island; the Long Island date is a ticketed concert at Stereo Garden. Booking email is their agent at Atomic Music Group, published on the band site. A second site photo has a photographer watermark ("KING") and the crowd photos show fans, so both were skipped. Photo 1 shows stage props from Nirvana's In Utero tour (anatomical angel mannequins) - owner may prefer to skip it.
description: A touring Nirvana tribute band based in Chicago and fronted by Paul Wandtke (ex-Trivium). They play songs from Bleach, Nevermind, In Utero and MTV Unplugged, live without backing tracks, and sometimes do an acoustic "Unplugged" show, as at Stereo Garden in Patchogue.

logo.alt: Smells Like Nirvana Tribute logo: yellow lettering above a yellow smiley face with X eyes and a tongue sticking out

photos.alt: Smells Like Nirvana guitarist playing on a smoky stage with the drummer behind him and angel-winged mannequin props like Nirvana's In Utero tour

evidence.note: Stereo Garden (Patchogue) lists Smells Like Nirvana performing MTV Unplugged on Sunday Oct 4, 2026; says the band is based in Chicago and fronted by Paul Wandtke.
Official site links Instagram and YouTube, lists a Patchogue, NY date and tour dates across the U.S. and Europe, and gives a booking email.
Paul Wandtke's own site confirms he leads the tribute and links facebook.com/smellslikenirvanatribute.
